function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | Description | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|-------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines the length of boxers with the snugness of briefs. | Everyday wear, sports, travel. | • Full‑leg coverage
• Good support
• Breathable fabrics (cotton, modal, bamboo)
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑leg, snug fit that sits at the waist. | Work, gym, casual wear. | • Tight fit for support
• Minimal fabric at hips
• Often made from cotton or microfiber | | **Trunks** | Shorter than boxer briefs, longer than briefs. | Modern look, active wear. | • Hip‑high cut
• Less bulk
• Usually cotton or performance blends | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑leg, relaxed fit. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Maximum airflow
• Soft cotton or modal
• Often printed or plain | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive, often with a higher waistband. | Athletic performance, recovery. | • Muscle support
• Moisture‑wicking
• Usually polyester or nylon blends | | **Boys’ Style (Boyshorts)** | Hip‑high, full coverage, similar to women’s boyshorts. | Trendy fashion, some athletes. | • Full coverage
• Often made from spandex blends | | **Underwire (for men)** | Rare, but some brands offer a light “underwire” for extra support. | Men who need extra lift or have larger chests. | • Light support
• Usually in briefs or boxer briefs | --- ## How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity (sleep, lounging):** Boxers or loose briefs. - **Moderate activity (work, light exercise):** Boxer briefs or trunks. - **High activity (sports, heavy lifting):** Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband:** Should sit comfortably at the natural waist, not too tight or too loose. Look for elastic bands with a soft inner lining. - **Hip and Thigh Coverage:** Avoid styles that leave gaps or bunch up. Boxer briefs and trunks usually strike a good balance. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton:** Soft, breathable, great for everyday wear. Look for 100% cotton or a blend with modal for added softness. - **Performance Blends (polyester, nylon, spandex):** Moisture‑wicking, quick‑dry, and stretchable. Ideal for sports. - **Bamboo or Tencel:** Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial, and very breathable. - **Silk or Satin:** Luxury feel, good for special occasions or sleep. 4. **Seam Construction** - **Flat‑lock seams** reduce friction and minimize chafing. - **Seamless or 3‑D knitting** offers a smooth feel against the skin. 5. **Durability & Care** - Check the care label: most underwear can be machine washed, but some performance fabrics may need cold water or no‑tumble drying. - Look for reinforced stitching at stress points (waistband, crotch). --- ## Top Brands (as of 2024) | Brand | Known For | Signature Style | |-------|-----------|-----------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs and boxer briefs | Iconic waistband, smooth cotton | | **Hanes** | Affordable, durable | Classic briefs, boxer briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Ultra‑soft fabrics, minimalist design | AIRism line (breathable, moisture‑wicking) | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑first, anti‑chafe | ComfyCotton briefs, boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Innovative pouch design | Boxer briefs with ergonomic pouch | | **Under Armour** | Performance fabrics | Compression briefs, boxer briefs | | **Lululemon** | Premium, stretchy | Lululemon’s “Fast” line (breathable, supportive) | | **MeUndies** | Soft, sustainable | Cotton‑modal blends, fun prints | | **Polo Ralph Lauren** | Classic, high‑quality | Polo briefs, boxer briefs | --- ## Quick Buying Checklist | Item | Why It Matters | |------|----------------| | **Size** | Fit is everything. Use brand size charts; consider waist and inseam. | | **Waistband** | Look for a soft, elastic band with a smooth inner lining. | | **Fabric** | Match fabric to your needs (cotton for everyday, performance for sports). | | **Seam Type** | Flat‑lock or seamless for comfort. | | **Return Policy** | Especially if trying a new brand or style. | | **Price vs. Quality** | Higher price often means better durability and comfort. | --- ## Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort and versatility:** Boxer briefs are the safest bet. - **For maximum airflow and relaxation:** Boxers or loose briefs. - **For athletic performance:** Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. - **For a modern, stylish look:** Trunks or boys’ style. Try a few different styles and fabrics to see what feels best for your body type and lifestyle. Happy shopping!
